findings.statement: The subject is a strategy reassessment record (digest 8c886ef5...) for objective-000001, bound to context 17eb058a..., which is delivered and matches scientific_context.current exactly (route-000001 selected for obligation-000001; strategies reduce-and-translate on node-000001 and prove-the-barrier-first on node-000002; acceptance-000001 accepted with outcome reduction and claims_openness false). The record asserts no mathematical result and neither proves nor disproves the root claim 43d81023... (girth-six Sidorenko). It records two dispositions and one ordering: (a) node-000001 retire under reduce-and-translate, on the evidence acceptance-000001 / checkpoint-000001 / journal move 1; I verified that acceptance-000001 is accepted in the current context, that its milestone c2-reduces-to-problem-1-5 is the equivalence of the C_2 claim with Problem 1.5, and that the delivered CKLL full text (a662797f...) states Problem 1.5 'lies outside the reach of current methods', so the retire reason is accurate; (b) node-000002 continue under prove-the-barrier-first, with next action 'reserve move 1, write the barrier proof with the general pairwise sign model, the conditional rank-layer assumption and the derivation of the limit, bind the full text of the reported counterexample'; (c) strategy_order [node-000002] with plan bindings problem 5bdd8ca9..., preconditions 44c2bf89..., openings 7c4fa4a3..., ranking 1746c10d..., all delivered and mutually consistent (preconditions give verdict yes for attack-the-negative-side and prove-the-barrier-first; the ranking places the barrier first with a written reason, namely that the one disproof mechanism depends on pairs of points in two faces and a girth-six pattern has none, so the transfer question is decided before any construction). I checked the mathematical core of the continue reason against the passages of [161] transcribed in strategy study 593e11a3...: a pair of points lying in two faces of an incidence pattern is exactly a 4-cycle, so a girth-six pattern has none; under the transcribed (3.2)-(3.4), a face factor present alone averages to 1 over its sign eta_e, so the limiting sign model would be identically 1 and the leading-order deficit of [161] would vanish. This is a coherent, bounded barrier hypothesis, correctly scoped as leading-order and conditional on the analogue of the rank-layer limit (Lemma 3.1 of [161], proved there only for its 35-vertex complex). The what_changed items that are checkable are correct: the previous context 655d28e6... has no selected route and one strategy; the revised problem and novelty studies (d199a853..., 8c454e59...) record the closure of MathOverflow question 515955. Nothing beyond these planning dispositions is approved.
